difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled theorem at source lines 1855-1857: the n-th homotopy group of the n-sphere is the integers. The proof (source lines 1859-1865) is an induction on n whose step is not visible in the statement: the two entries of the diagonal that the author has already computed are the base cases, and for n at least two the numerical hypothesis n at most 2n-2 makes the stability theorem applicable, which identifies the group in degree n+1 of the (n+1)-sphere with the group in degree n of the n-sphere and closes the step with the inductive hypothesis. Short as it is, the proof carries the whole reduction from the general statement to the two computed entries, and both the range check that licenses stability and the induction are written out in the retained text.
